title: American Public University System Hosts System-wide Virtual Career Fair “Pathways to Possibilities”
summary: American Public University System Hosts System-wide Virtual Career Fair “Pathways to Possibilities”
body_markdown:
## Free and Open to the Public, the Nationwide Virtual Event Connects Participants with Employers Across Healthcare, Technology, Business, Government and More


**Charles Town, WV – October 14, 2026** –[American Public University System (the System)](https://www.apus.edu/) will host a Nationwide Virtual Career Fair, “Pathways to Possibilities,” on Wednesday, Oct. 21, 2026, from 11 a.m. to 3 p.m. ET.


For the first time, all four of the System’s academic units, American Military University (AMU), American Public University (APU), Rasmussen University and Hondros College of Nursing, will participate in the event, bringing together students, alumni and job seekers with employers from around the country.


This free, open to the public event makes it easy to join from anywhere with internet access.[Register today](https://app.premiervirtual.com/events/57bd072a-bb1f-49b7-8e40-f28bba264cde/2026-nationwide-virtual-career-fair/attendee) !


The “Pathways to Possibilities” Nationwide Virtual Career Fair will give participants the opportunity to connect with recruiters and representatives from leading public- and private-sector employers nationwide in high-demand fields, including healthcare, technology, business and government.


“Career readiness continues to be an essential part of our University System mission to transform lives, advance careers and improve communities locally and globally, in response to industry needs,” said Angela Selden, Chancellor of American Public University System. “This event connects students and graduates, educated for service, with employers and opportunities.”


American Public University System’s four academic units offer more than 290 degree programs in fields ranging from nursing and healthcare to cybersecurity, information technology, business, criminal justice, intelligence, education, public service and more.


Nearly 900 people registered to attend last year’s Nationwide Virtual Career Fair hosted jointly by AMU, APU and Rasmussen University with 308 guests submitting job applications during the event.


Career services teams across American Public University System’s academic units support students and alumni with resources including interview preparation, resume assistance, career exploration, professional development and opportunities to connect with employers. To learn more about career services at each academic unit, visit:[Career Services (AMU)](https://www.amu.apus.edu/career-services/) ,[Career Services (APU)](https://www.apu.apus.edu/career-services/) ,[Rasmussen University Career Services](https://www.rasmussen.edu/student-experience/career-services/) , and[Hondros College of Nursing Resources](https://catalog.apus.edu/hondros/about/resources/) .


Don’t miss your chance to register for the[2026 Nationwide Virtual Career Fair](https://app.premiervirtual.com/events/57bd072a-bb1f-49b7-8e40-f28bba264cde/2026-nationwide-virtual-career-fair/attendee) .


**About American Public University System**


American Public University System empowers students through education to transform lives, advance careers, and serve their communities locally and globally. With approximately 109,000 students and over 250,0001 alumni worldwide, the System includes[American Military University](https://www.amu.apus.edu/) (AMU),[American Public University](https://www.apu.apus.edu/) (APU),[Rasmussen University](https://www.rasmussen.edu/) , and[Hondros College of Nursing](https://www.hondros.edu/) .


The[System](https://www.apus.edu/) is accredited by the[Higher Learning Commission](https://www.hlcommission.org/) , an institutional accreditation agency recognized by the U.S. Department of Education. The System is a wholly owned subsidiary of[American Public Education, Inc.](https://www.apei.com/) (Nasdaq: APEI)


1As of June 30, 2026.


The System, including AMU, APU, RU, and HCN, is not affiliated with the U.S. Military or American University.
